typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	v_SysBatchLogKey as string (),
	v_TempTable_ScheduleClaims as string ()
}

source(output(
		ClaimID as string,
		ISCRW as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Select distinct   CASE WHEN RIGHT(SCCL.ClaimID,3) = \'CRW\'       THEN SUBSTRING(SCCL.ClaimID,0,LEN(SCCL.ClaimID)-2)        ELSE 	SCCL.ClaimID        END  							                             As ClaimID ,CASE WHEN RIGHT(SCCL.ClaimID,3) = \'CRW\'       THEN 1       ELSE 	0       END  							                             As ISCRW From EIDS_ENC.Application.SystemLog                               SYLG (nolock) Inner Join														        EIDS_ENC.Application.ScheduleLog                                   SCDH (nolock) On  SYLG.SystemLogCategoryID                                         = 1001 And SYLG.IsActive                                                    = 1 And SYLG.SystemLogVal01                                              = SCDH.ScheduleID And SCDH.IsActive                                                    = 1 Inner Join EIDS_ENC.Application.ScheduleClaimsLog SCCL (nolock) On SCDH.SysScheduleLogKey                                           = SCCL.SysScheduleLogKey And SCDH.ScheduleID													= SCCL.ScheduleID                        Inner Join														        EIDS_ENC.Application.ScheduleApplSourcesLog                        SCAS (nolock) On SCDH.SysScheduleLogKey                                           = SCAS.SysScheduleLogKey And SCDH.ScheduleID                                                  = SCAS.ScheduleID Inner Join														        EIDS_ENC.vwConfig.ApplSources												  APPL (nolock) On SCAS.ApplSourceID                                                = APPL.ApplSourceID And APPL.IsActive													= 1 Where APPL.ApplSourceID											    = ? AND SYLG.SystemLogKey = ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ODSGetConfigApplSources
ODSGetConfigApplSources sink(input(
		ClaimID as string,
		IsCRW as boolean
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ClaimID,
		IsCRW = ISCRW)) ~> ODDencGMLoadConfigApplSources
